findings.desc: 6/9 verificationIntent entries are stale (headHash mismatch): CHK-001:happy:0, CHK-001:edge:0, CHK-001:adversarial:0, CHK-002:happy:0, CHK-002:edge:0, CHK-002:adversarial:0. All six carry evidence whose headHash predates the current HEAD (a2efffe). validate reports 3/9 covered, 6 required missing. The evidence commands for the stale intents were recorded against earlier commits and have not been re-bound after the final hardening commit. Until re-stamped they do not satisfy the must-coverage requirement for a normal-channel story.

CHK-001:happy:0 and CHK-001:adversarial:0 are bound to evidence commands that do not directly exercise the toOwnPropsNullProto chokepoint or the pollution surface for those intents. CHK-001:happy:0 cites usage-ledger-adapter-smoke.js (a pre-existing round-trip smoke that does not call toOwnPropsNullProto directly or assert Object.getPrototypeOf===null). CHK-001:adversarial:0 cites usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke.js (codex/gemini path smoke, not the whitelist-drop or null-proto property assertions). The intent text explicitly requires asserting null-prototype and whitelist-drop behavior. The pollution smoke (usage-ledger-prototype-pollution-smoke.js) does assert these via checks 1-4 (helper direct tests) and checks 5/8/10 (billing preserved), but neither of the cited commands drives those assertions. This is a command-to-intent binding mismatch per the evidence-must-bind-literal-intent-command rule.

CHK-003:adversarial:0 evidence note honestly discloses that the estimate path pollution assertion (check 17 in the smoke, labeled LOAD-BEARING) passes even pre-hardening by design, because the estimate path computes inputTokens from prompt bytes and sets output/cache to literal null — it never reads any token key off an externally-derived usage object. However, the smoke labels this check LOAD-BEARING in the check label string itself (line 353: estimate (LOAD-BEARING): ...). This label is inaccurate at the source level: a reader inspecting the smoke code sees a LOAD-BEARING label for an assertion that the evidence note concedes is not load-bearing. The CHK-003:adversarial:0 intent requires ALL pollution assertions to be load-bearing. The evidence note provides accurate disclosure but the smoke label creates a contradiction that must be resolved: either remove the LOAD-BEARING label from check 17 and add a clear NOT-LOAD-BEARING annotation, or remove the check from the load-bearing count and add an advisory note in the smoke. The current state where the code says LOAD-BEARING and the note says it is not is a honesty gap.
